requirements.evidence: Research/Projects/BinaryTreeReduction/Reduction.lean:11-13 rounds each internal-node sum. Submission.lean:59-61 applies this theorem to the rounded product tree; Tree.lean:43-47 proves mapping preserves depth.

requirements.requirement: Establish the gamma(depth+1,u) componentwise perturbation bound.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:63-74 composes multiplication and addition errors to u + gamma(depth,u)*(1+u), then bounds it by gamma(depth+1,u) using gamma_step. Gamma.lean:8-9 defines gamma(k,u)=k*u/(1-k*u), and lines 33-54 prove the step under smallness.

requirements.requirement: Use only the stated model and smallness assumptions without assuming or restricting the conclusion.
